prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet village market at dawn. On the left stands an old woman in a blue shawl, her posture slightly hunched as she holds out a woven basket. In the center, a young boy in a striped shirt reaches eagerly to accept the basket from her hands, marking their first interaction of exchange. Beside him on the right, a spotted cat sits calmly on a wooden crate, its tail wrapped neatly around its paws, displaying a pose of relaxed stillness. Behind the boy, a tall man in a brown coat points toward the horizon, directing attention away from the immediate transaction. Next to the man, a grey donkey stands patiently, looking directly at the boy with gentle eyes, creating a second interaction of observation. The background remains sparse to emphasize these figures. There is no modern technology visible in this timeless setting. The soft lines and faint hues suggest the early morning chill without explicit description. The composition relies entirely on the distinct appearances and simple actions of these five entities to convey the narrative of the moment.
